column4: Description

Schema + ORM/migrations for every record type (Learner, Module, Lecture, Quiz/Question, FillInTheBlankQuestion, Enrolment, QuizAttempt/BlankAttempt, Certificate, Material assets/groups, StaffMember, Law, Tool, DynamicOptionList/OptionValue, RegistrationApplication, LecturerProfile + sub-entries, Review, Announcement/MessageThread, AuditEntry, PlatformSettings) and the relationships between them.

Learner and staff sign-in (with 2-step verification for staff), password rules (8/12 char minimums), session expiry (8h idle), and the full role/permission model for all seven roles enforced server-side.
Real upload/storage/delivery for Materials Library assets, video hosting/streaming for lectures, and Law document files - all non-functional placeholders in the prototype.
Transactional email service: password resets, staff invitations, registration decision emails (approved/rejected), certificate-given notices, and any in-app notification delivery.
Append-only action log (who/what/when) that is genuinely immutable at the database level, not just hidden in the UI; 7-year retention.
The single-record platform settings store (brand fields, registration toggle, chatbot knowledge-base paragraph, etc.) read across every console.
Marketing pages, and the province-based registration application -> provincial approval -> status/resubmit flow that replaced open self-signup. Landing-page redesign itself is client-deferred.
Dashboard, module catalogue/enrolment, lecture consumption, Quiz engine, Fill-in-the-blank engine, certificates (view + real PDF/design), profile & settings, module/lecturer reviews.
The Laws tab and Tools tab (browse, province ordering), and the learner assistant/chatbot - a real build likely means a real LLM reading live catalogue data instead of keyword search.

Lecturer dashboard, module/lecture management, lecture + quiz + fill-in-blank authoring (incl. a real rich-text/video tool), linking related Laws/Tools to a lecture, lecturer profile/credentials, learner progress visibility.

Platform dashboard/analytics, module creation, lecturer account suspension, cross-province learner oversight, certificate oversight, console account management, audit log viewer, platform settings screen.
Own-module editing/tagging/publishing, own-module lecturer assignment, reviews and certificates scoped to that module.
Global Law entity management - create/edit/tag/publish/archive.
Global Tool entity management, same shape as Laws.
Dynamic option lists (Hazards, Categories, and future lists) used to tag Modules/Laws/Tools.
Per-province application approval queue, scoped learner oversight.
Announcements (one-way, audience-targeted) and Messages (two-way, fixed valid pairs) between admin/lecturer/student, plus the notification bell/feed.
Certificate generation/reference numbering, withdrawal, and the no-login public lookup page.
Shared asset/group system used by lecturers and admins to attach files to lectures.
Module and lecturer reviews, and the shared moderation queue used by Super Admin / Module Admin.
The "found by shared tags, never manually linked" logic that relates Modules to Laws and Tools, and lets a lecturer curate a subset onto one lecture.
Server-side enforcement of every permission check, data retention rules (learner records, 7-year audit log), data minimisation.
